_comment: Read by scripts/audit-gate.mjs. Each entry accepts ONE advisory for ONE package until `expires` (UTC date, exclusive). Only HIGH can be accepted, only when npm offers no fix inside the declared range (none, or a semver-major one). Renewing an entry is a reviewed change, not an edit to keep CI green.

exceptions.justification: Memory exhaustion while validating oversized constrained collections: a denial of service of the process doing the validation, with no data exposure. The only fix is zod >= 4.6.6, a major that changes the public types of @codespar/api-types and @codespar/sdk consumed by codespar-enterprise and codespar-web; no patched 3.x exists. Renewed on 2026-11-09 for seven days only because of the mitigation in #245: a model's tool arguments, the untrusted input that reaches Zod in this repo, are bounded by @codespar/langchain before any schema parses them. The other parses in this repo read developer configuration and first-party API responses. Without #245 this renewal does not stand. The zod 4 migration is tracked in #214 with the coordinated bumps.
